basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old music enthusiast hailing from Chicago, deeply passionate about hip-hop, especially the lyrical genius of MF DOOM. By day, I work as a software developer, but my evenings are often spent exploring new music or diving into gaming worlds. Love anything that requires a bit of strategy or creativity, like Portal or Thaumcraft. I'm single but enjoy a vibrant social life online and offline, often attending local music gigs. Typically online during late evenings, a night owl at heart.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in music history with a particular focus on underground hip-hop artists. Developed coding skills through a computer science degree and continued learning through online courses and personal projects. Regularly keeps up with tech trends and gaming news.
